title: Chunked bodies
description:
Decode an HTTP body sent with `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`.

```
4
Wiki
5
pedia
E
 in

chunks.
0


-> "Wikipedia in

chunks."
```
hints: Keep a small state machine: reading a size line, reading data, reading the `\r\n` after the data, done (lesson 3.02).
`std::stoul(line, &used, 16)` reads the size; check `used == line.size()` (or stop at `;`, which starts an extension).
requirements: Each chunk is a hex length, `\r\n`, that many bytes, `\r\n`; a length of 0 ends the body.
Feed the data in pieces of any size, as it arrives from a socket.
Report broken input (a bad hex number or a missing `\r\n`).
stretch: Handle trailer headers after the 0 chunk.
